summary: Moderating US inflation this week reinforced bets that the Fed will hold rates in September, sending stocks to fresh highs and compressing volatility. Meanwhile, geopolitical risk from the Strait of Hormuz crisis persists — Iran and Oman have yet to reach an accord to reopen the waterway, keeping energy markets on edge and supporting gold's relative strength versus equities.
tweet: Cooling inflation is killing the September hike thesis, pushing stocks to records — but the Strait of Hormuz standoff keeps a floor under gold and energy risk.
